recovery.do_en: The risk-off may be nearing its end. Begin scaling exposure back in tranches — keep stops, let price confirm the low. Don't chase the first bounce.

recovery.caveat_en: Illustrative context, not a buy trigger. It reads the radar's own intensity trajectory (leak-free) plus the display-only central-bank liquidity series; unlike the alert legs it is not forward-tested yet, and risk can re-accelerate. The de-risk → re-risk response is sizing, scaled in deliberately. BoJ enters only via the aggregate global central-bank tide (no isolated BoJ feed).
recovery.caveat_zh: 仅为示意性背景，并非买入信号。它读取雷达自身的强度轨迹（无未来函数）以及仅供展示的央行流动性序列；不同于警报腿，此读数尚未经前瞻检验，风险可能再度加速。降险→回补的应对是仓位管理、分批进行。日本央行仅通过全球央行总潮汐体现（无独立日本数据源）。

memo.summary: Context-only committee read: the surface has shifted back to risk-on and the risk radar is calm/receding, with a measured 21-day pullback rate of 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. That de-escalates the earlier growth, internals, and bubble warnings, but it does not establish a fresh bullish confirmation: market_confirmed is false, no confirmation chip is fresh, breadth remains weak, and the global-breakdown leg remains elevated. The confirmed Q3 label is low-confidence and transitioning because its current axes read Q2. Cross-asset bonds/FX still diverge from the equity regime. Factor intelligence adds no active contradiction: Pair G is dormant because the panel has only 10 dates, the scorecard is explicitly survivorship-biased, and factor attention has zero graded firings. No ranked surface or trade posture was changed.
what_fired: World-state verdict returned to RISK_ON; radar moved from caution to calm and is receding.
Liquidity is supportive only as low-quality mechanical plumbing context; RRP is exhausted and there is no Fed asset-growth impulse.
Dealer gamma changed from short to long, while systematic flows remain split.
The confirmed regime label is Q3, but raw growth/inflation signs read Q2 and are only 1 of 7 sessions into confirmation.
Two confluence tensions remain: briefing demand-versus-supply divergences and bonds/FX versus the equity regime.
A causal hypothesis was staked only for forward testing: low-vol Fed net-liquidity deceleration preceding 21-day breadth deterioration.
memo.contradictions_review: Primary contradiction: risk-on/calm surface versus weak internal participation—31.8% above the 50-day average, breadth divergence present, zero fresh market-confirmation chips, and global-breakdown intensity 86.8. Second: the low-confidence Q3 label conflicts with its own Q2-sign axes and with bonds/FX cross-asset confirmation. Options contradiction records are older (as of 2026-09-09) and therefore were not elevated. Factor Pair G has no records and cannot resolve the tension. Current contradictions also make the many overdue Master Brain theses unsafe to treat as live context; notably the Long Treasuries falsifier includes real 10-year yield above 2.5%, while the current reading is 2.68%.

deserves_operator: Resolve or annotate the Q3→Q2 regime transition and the continuing bonds/FX contradiction before relying on the regime label.
Watch whether weak breadth/global breakdown converges with the risk-on headline; use the pre-committed 45% breadth and global-intensity criteria, not discretion.
Score, close, or explicitly renew the overdue Master Brain theses. The Long Treasuries thesis deserves immediate review because its stated real-yield falsifier has been met.
Treat liquidity support as transient mechanical context: RRP is exhausted, so a renewed drain would transmit directly to reserves.
